relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: EA treatment, particularly at 1.0 mA, significantly alleviated paclitaxel-induced mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia

key_findings: Electroacupuncture (1.0 mA best) alleviated paclitaxel-induced allodynia and hyperalgesia in mice.
Paclitaxel raised TLR4, P2X7, NLRP3, NF-kB, IL-1beta, IL-18 in DRG and spinal cord, reversed by EA.
